headword: {薩長同盟|さっちょうどうめい}

definitions.explanation: The secret alliance of 1866 between the domains of Satsuma and Chōshū, brokered by Sakamoto Ryōma, which joined the two strongest enemies of the Tokugawa shogunate and led to its fall and the Meiji Restoration.

examples.japanese: {薩長同盟|さっちょうどうめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結|むす}ばれた→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
{薩長同盟|さっちょうどうめい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1866⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧できごとだ。
examples.english: The Satsuma-Chōshū Alliance was an event of 1866.

examples.japanese: ⟦{坂本龍馬|さかもとりょうま}→坂本龍馬：31007_sakamotoryouma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薩長同盟|さっちょうどうめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Sakamoto Ryōma is known for having brokered the Satsuma-Chōshū Alliance.

notes:
{薩長|さっちょう} is ⟦{薩摩|さつま}→薩摩：33115_satsuma⟧ plus ⟦{長州|ちょうしゅう}→長州：33683_choushuu⟧. The two domains had fought each other in 1864, so the alliance surprised the shogunate; once united they pushed through ⟦{倒幕|とうばく}→倒幕：16248_toubaku⟧ (overthrowing the shogunate) and dominated the early Meiji government.

- {薩長|さっちょう}⟦{連合|れんごう}→連合：14450_rengou⟧: another name for the alliance
